name: Ithamar
description: Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: Aaron and his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar are taken from among the children of Israel to minister unto the Most High in the priest's office.

note.label: Exodus 28: Holy Garments for Glory and for Beauty

points: This is the sum of the tabernacle: a collection was taken in order to fund the building of the tabernacle and the service of building it, counted according to the commandment of Moses by the hand of Ithamar son to Aaron the priest.

note.label: Exodus 38: The Altar, the Court, and the Sum of the Offering

points: Aaron, Eleazar, and Ithamar were told, uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes, lest ye die and wrath come upon all the people; basically they were told not to mourn for them, because Nadab and Abihu died in the midst of sin and what they did was abominable to the Most High. The whole house of Israel would bewail the burning which the Lord kindled.

note.label: Leviticus 10: Strange Fire and the Charge of the Priesthood

points: Moses told Aaron, Eleazar, and Ithamar to take the meat offering that remained of the offerings made by fire and eat it without leaven beside the altar, in the holy place, for it was their due; and the wave breast and heave shoulder were eaten in a clean place, the due of Aaron and his sons and his daughters by a statute for ever.

note.label: Leviticus 10: Strange Fire and the Charge of the Priesthood

points: Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering, and behold, it was burnt; and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, because the Most High had given it to them to bear the iniquity of the congregation, and seeing the blood of it was not brought in within the holy place, they should indeed have eaten it in the holy place, as he commanded.

note.label: Leviticus 10: Strange Fire and the Charge of the Priesthood

points: Their charge was under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest. Ithamar had to make sure the priests had covered all the most holy things before the Gershonites came in to bear them; he was responsible for the lives of all the Gershonites that served, and he had to be in order.

note.label: Numbers 4: The Service of the Tabernacle Done in Order

points: The sons of Merari were numbered from thirty to fifty years old, charged with the boards, bars, pillars, sockets, pins, and cords of the tabernacle and the court, reckoned by name, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron.
Only Eleazar and Ithamar were left to oversee, because Nadab and Abihu were killed by the Lord for offering strange fire; there were only two sons of Aaron remaining.

note.label: Numbers 4: The Service of the Tabernacle Done in Order

points: The Lord told Moses to take the wagons and oxen for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation and give them to the Levites, to every man according to his service: two wagons and four oxen to the sons of Gershon, and four wagons and eight oxen to the sons of Merari, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

note.label: Numbers 7: The Offering of the Princes at the Dedication of the Altar

points: These are the divisions of the sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. Nadab and Abihu died before their father and had no children, so Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest's office. David distributed them according to their offices in their service.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 24: The Divisions and Courses of the Priests

points: There were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar, sixteen of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar. They were divided by lot, one sort with another, and Shemaiah the scribe wrote them before the king and the princes, taking record for each.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 24: The Divisions and Courses of the Priests
